newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 28.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Contract engineer said after trading closed on Friday that it was in contractual disputes with the owner of the Yolanda nitrates project in Chile, Minera Yolanda SCM, a subsidiary of Canada's Kap Resources Ltd. After negotiations faltered, both sides have lodged claims against the other.

Jeans retailer said on Monday it was to bid for N.Z.-based womenswear retailer, Underground Fashions, at 33.5 cents per share. For the year to july 31, 1996, Undergound had sales of NZ$27.5 million and reported a net loss of NZ$2.6 million.

Healthcare/telecommunications/logistics group is to offer a new plan to resolve the legal brouhaha over Optus Vision, according to the Sydney Morning Herald on Tuesday. Resolution of the dispute would ease the way for the Optus Communication float to get back on track.
